items.text: Commanders QB Jayden Daniels is officially out Sunday; Marcus Mariota will start again vs. the Colts.
items.why: Elbow injury; not quite ready per coach Quinn.
items.implication: Mariota gets another start; Commanders passing game ceiling lowered.

items.text: Eagles WR DeVonta Smith (hamstring) not expected to play Sunday vs. Rams; little optimism after consecutive DNPs.
items.implication: Hurts loses top target; pass-catching group thinned further with Goedert already out.
items.opportunity: Elevated targets/routes for Wicks and others.

items.text: Saints placing RB Travis Etienne on injured reserve due to hamstring injury; will miss minimum four games.
items.implication: Season-long absence opens clear committee work for remaining backs.
items.opportunity: Increased snaps/carries for Kamara and Miller.

items.text: Bears RB D'Andre Swift added to injury report with knee, held out of Thursday practice (DNP); status for Week 4 vs Jets to monitor.
items.implication: Potential reduction or sit risk; handcuff elevation if worsens.

items.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson (back) and WR Zay Flowers (hamstring) upgraded to full participants Thursday.
items.implication: Both expected to play at full capacity; Ravens offense stabilized.
items.opportunity: Full snap/route shares; Flowers high target efficiency noted.

items.text: LOVE Jaylen Warren @ CLE (TNF): led all RBs with 90% snap rate last week, 20 of 22 RB touches; Cleveland allows 88+ rush yards every game; workhorse with Dowdle out.
items.why: Elite usage/snap share on short week; matchup.

items.text: LOVE Drake London @ NO: 35% career target share/104 ypg with Penix; 43.5% share last week (9-194); NO allows 5th-most WR TDs.
items.why: Penix chemistry and volume; soft matchup.
items.opportunity: High target share and red-zone looks.

items.text: Dolphins RB De'Von Achane suffered torn ACL in Week 3, ending his season; creates immediate backfield opportunity.
items.implication: Season over; top waiver priority for Miami RBs.

items.text: Rams HC Sean McVay expects WR Puka Nacua (groin/hip) to play Sunday vs. Eagles after progressing in practice.
items.implication: Major upgrade for Rams offense and Stafford; reverse prior beneficiary elevation for Adams.
items.opportunity: High snap/route/target share return as WR1.

items.text: In fresh ETR ROS Top-150 (half-PPR), Kenneth Walker ranks as high as #3 overall; notable riser near the top alongside other role/usage adjustments.
items.why: Updated for injuries, schedule, roles; Walker stands out.
items.implication: Strong buy/hold; elite ROS RB value.

items.text: LOVE Garrett Wilson @ CHI: Mitchell likely out again; 36% target share last time Mitchell sidelined; 78% catch rate, 9.0 YPT; CHI allows 14+ YPR.
items.why: Clear WR1 volume without Mitchell; efficient.

items.text: HATE Omarion Hampton @ SEA: RB27 utilization, 3.5% target share, 25% routes, snap rate down to 42% Week 3, only 13% third-down; SEA allows 2.9 YPC (2nd-fewest).
items.why: Declining role + brutal run defense matchup.

items.text: HATE Kyle Pitts @ NO: 16% target share and 34 ypg career with Penix; under 8 FP in 9 of 13 such games; TE37 utilization this year.
Kyle Pitts has just six targets through three games, none inside the 10, low aDOT; among worst underperformers relative to opportunity so far.
items.why: Low target volume, no red-zone work, underperformance chart.
items.implication: Fade or sell-low; limited fantasy ceiling with Penix.
items.conflict: Berry also hates Pitts on similar low-share data.
